# What a split promised, turned into something that fails the build.
#
# One row per split:  <source-path> <pre-split-sha> <destination-glob>...
#
# Every non-blank line of the source, as it was at that commit, must still be
# present in one of the destinations. `check-brief-coverage.py` has the whole
# argument, including why this asserts *at least one* rather than *exactly one*.
#
# **Rows are meant to be deleted.** One release after a split has landed, the
# modules are the thing being maintained and the pre-split file is only history;
# a row left here past that point turns every deleted sentence red.
#
# **Pin a SHA that is on `main`.** A commit from the branch the split was written
# on is reachable in that working copy and in no fresh clone, so the check goes
# green locally and red in CI with `cannot read <path> at <sha>` — which reads
# like the file moved rather than like the pin did.

# Added 2026-08-14 with kolonie-docs#363, which cut AGENTS.md from 2.021 lines
# into a 181-line core plus eight routed modules.
